mechanism.query: FUNC_80038F38 returns zero unless player+0x82 equals 1; otherwise it maps the current player sector through the runtime sector table and returns its signed region code at +0x2e.
mechanism.dispatch: The player update calls the query, rejects an already-set completion latch, and takes the region-code-2 branch. It stores latch 1, timer 23, and requests SFX 58.
mechanism.consumer: scene_flow_dispatcher observes the latch and timer; after the timer reaches zero it calls transition_finalizer_subsystem_reset.
mechanism.handoff: The MEMORY results overlay enters FUNC_800B7DA0 and later calls the same finalizer at 0x800b8750 to continue.
mechanism.classification: F01 uses the resident collision-sector completion path, not the LEVEL1.BIN generic finale path.
